svg.title: Multi-Channel Notification System — End-to-End Fan-Out Architecture
svg.desc: Comprehensive multi-channel notification architecture showing trigger services, stateless gateway with AppKey auth and template compilation, user/device lookup, channel-isolated priority queues, deduplicated workers with exponential backoff, third-party delivery providers, and delivery tracking funnel.
svg.text: Multi-Channel Notification System — End-to-End Fan-Out Architecture
Stateless Ingestion Gateway · Channel-Isolated Priority Queues · Deduplication & Rate Limits · 3P Delivery · Tracking Funnel
Autoscaling worker pods per channel load
Apple APNs: HTTP/2 JWT token auth
Google FCM: HTTP v1 OAuth2 API
Data Persistence & Schemas · Idempotency Window · Retry Backoff · Event Tracking Funnel & Token Hygiene
Storage Schema, Deduplication & Resilience State Machine
Relational Database Schemas (User, Device, Settings, Log)
users: { user_id (PK), email, phone_number, timezone, locale }
Returns OK: Lock acquired -> Forward to provider dispatch worker
Returns NIL: Duplicate seen -> Drop event & log dedup_hit
Circuit Breaker: 50% errors in 10s -> Failover to backup vendor
Event Tracking Lifecycle Funnel & Token Hygiene Loop
Automated Device Token Hygiene Feedback Loop
APNs 410 Unregistered / FCM invalid registration token
Webhook emits InvalidTokenEvent to Kafka hygiene topic
Hygiene Worker executes: UPDATE device_tokens SET is_active=false
Prunes dead tokens; cuts egress bills & prevents APNs throttling
All funnel webhook events stream to Kafka tracking topic
ClickHouse ingestion: delivery rate, CTR, bounce rate, SLA
Alert engine triggers automatic vendor failover in < 60s
